args.title: Use configured public URL for password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (falling back to "http://localhost:3000") to construct BASE_URL, aligning email links with the application's configured public URL.
